title: Morocco
summary: Late October 2026, three candidate itineraries for the same trip — all gravel/MTB in the High Atlas, all loops or point to point with no out-and-backs. Compare them here and argue it out in the comments.

title: Taurus
summary: Late October 2026, the tarmac alternative to Morocco: three ways to cross the Toros from Antalya to Mersin at roughly 100 km and 2,000 m a day. Two distinct routes — an inland spine and a coast-and-cols line — plus the inland one compressed into six days if the week is shorter. Argue it out in the comments.
